items.description: Permission in `resource.action` form. The source closes this to a 94-value enum, but live organization roles carry values that enum omits (`adminDataview.*`, `availability.*`, `ooo.*`, `apiKey.*`, `team.manage`, `booking.manage`, `routingForm.manage` and more), so the contract accepts any string instead of refusing a valid role.

pagination.description: The source declares cursor metadata, but the live API answers the booking list with the offset metadata the other paginated endpoints use. Both shapes are accepted because the path carries no cal-api-version of its own.

data.description: The source types this as an array, but every endpoint that shares the shape — create, get one, patch one — answers with a single workflow object. The list endpoints use their own envelope.
